newsitem.title: USA: May Department to open nine stores in FY97.
newsitem.headline: May Department to open nine stores in FY97.

text.p: May Department Stores Co said Monday it expects to open nine new department stores through the rest of fiscal 1997.
These include nine Lord & Taylor stores, one Strawbridge's store, two Foley's units, and three Filene's stores. May operates 366 department stores currently in 30 states and the District of Columbia.
In the first quarter ended May 3, 1997, May opened four new department stores. These included three Lord & Taylor units and one Strawbridge's.
Earlier, May reported earnings from continuing operations of $0.38 a share on 252.3 million shares outstanding, compared with $0.36 on 265.8 million shares a year ago.

The decline in the shares outstanding reflects a share buyback program. May said a $600 million stock repurchase program was completed at fiscal year-end 1996, and its $300 million buyback program for fiscal 1997 is about three-quarters completed.
